description: Repository deployment boundary coverage driven from an API/inline config selection: the PYTHON_3 runtime, a caller-supplied source-connection ARN reflected in the authentication section, and repository-URL normalization (trailing slash dropped, surrounding whitespace trimmed) applied during request assembly. Also exercises the deployment-mode toggle: with automatic redeployment the request carries an inline (API) code-configuration block, while selecting manual redeployment resolves the request to repository-supplied configuration with no inline block.
